NVMI · 2025-12-31

Nova dimensional, materials and chemical metrology supports GAA, memory and advanced packaging. Reviewed operating EV scenarios are USD 2.020bn downcycle, 4.071bn base and 6.316bn upside; no scenario probabilities or current price targets are assigned.

31 December 2025 discount/capital origin; information through 18 October 2026. Dated operating EV only. Later operating evidence and October discount inputs make this a retrospective-information analytical case, not a contemporaneous December backtest or October current valuation.

Base FY2026 sales = H1 actual 490.266 + Q3 guidance midpoint 282 + analyst Q4 assumption 300 = 1,072.266 million USD. Ten annual calendar-year forecasts cover 2026–2035; 2036 is the continuing year. Packaging overlaps logic/memory and is not an additive segment.

Economic operating margins include fresh equity compensation, physical depreciation and expensed R&D. Fresh grants cost 4.0% of revenue initially, fading to 3.5%. Legacy expense is displayed and identically reversed; no valuation uplift or duplicate future dilution is added.

Reviewed annual investment already includes physical capex less physical depreciation, incremental operating working capital and operating cash. Years 1–5 use the greater of positive sales growth / marginal sales-to-capital and the funding floor; years 6–10 fade to NOPAT × growth / ROIC while retaining the floor. Do not add those components twice. Every manual edit and simulation trial recomputes the selected source funding requirement. Entered investment is retained and topped up when necessary; terminal g/ROIC investment below its funding floor is rejected.

Marginal sales-to-capital assumptions are 1.6–2.0×. Revenue declines assume no working-capital release. Narrow historical book-capital returns exclude acquisition assets and R&D capital and are not sustainable economic ROIC.

Cash tax rates fade from 16.5% to 23%, above the management 15% target. Operating EBIT excludes interest earned on excess cash.

Base WACC fades from 10.97753678% to 9.592269%. October 16 Treasury 5.09%, US spread 0.22%, adjusted ERP 4.42% and sector beta 1.39 inform the model; debt weight, spread and mature beta are analyst assumptions. Down/up discount rates are base +120bp / −30bp.

Terminal growth is 2.5% / 3.0% / 3.5%, paired with ROIC 13% / 18% / 22%. Final explicit and continuing-year investment use NOPAT × growth / ROIC. End-year discounting starts at December 31, 2025.

December liquid assets are USD 1,633.241m; operating reserve is 26.41731m. The full quoted convertible claim is 936.270m, deducted once with no second principal or convertible-share charge. Year-end common shares are 31.780111m, distinct from 32.800m diluted weighted shares. These dated observations do not establish current common equity.

Common equity and per-share values are gated. Capped-call fair value, option value, performance-award completeness and residual claims are unresolved. The USD 51.826m historical capped-call premium is not fair value. Fixed dated convertible value is not jointly repriced across intrinsic scenarios. No current quote comparison, upside percentage or buyback execution is assumed.

New simulation defaults have zero width and are uncalibrated. Monte Carlo runs only on manual request. Named downcycle/base/upside scenarios have no assigned probabilities; zero-width trials reproduce the selected operating case while equity remains unavailable.

FY2016–2025 annual 20-F history retains field-level source URLs, filing dates, raw XBRL values and units. FY2021–2025 diluted-weighted-share scaling is corrected; FY2025 is 32.800m. Missing observations remain null. Acquisitions and the FY2016 royalty buyout limit comparability.

NVMI · 2025-12-31

Nova 的尺寸、材料和化学计量业务服务于 GAA、存储及先进封装。已复核经营企业价值情景为下行 20.20 亿、基准 40.71 亿、上行 63.16 亿美元；不赋予情景概率，也不是当前目标价。

折现及资本基准日为 2025 年 12 月 31 日；信息截至 2026 年 10 月 18 日。仅显示该基准日的经营企业价值。使用后续经营证据和十月折现参数，属于回溯信息分析，不是十二月实时回测，也不是十月当前估值。

2026 年基准收入为上半年实际 490.266 加第三季指引中点 282 加分析假设第四季 300，合计 1,072.266 百万美元。十年预测覆盖 2026–2035，2036 为持续经营年度。封装与逻辑及存储业务重叠，不可作为独立分部相加。

经济营业利润率已扣除新增股权薪酬、实物折旧和费用化研发。新增授予成本从收入的 4.0% 降至 3.5%。旧奖励费用展示后等额转回，不增加估值，也不重复计入未来稀释。

已复核年度投资包含实物资本开支减折旧、增量经营营运资本及经营现金。前五年取正收入增量除以边际销售资本比和资金下限的较大值；第六至十年向 NOPAT×增长率／ROIC 收敛，并保留资金下限。不可重复添加组成项。每次手工编辑及模拟试验均重新计算选定来源的资金需求。保留输入投资，不足时补足；终值 g/ROIC 投资低于资金下限时拒绝计算。

边际销售资本比假设为 1.6–2.0 倍。收入下降时不假定营运资本释放。历史狭义账面资本收益率不含收购资产及研发资本，不代表可持续经济 ROIC。

现金税率从 16.5% 过渡到 23%，高于管理层 15% 目标。营业利润不含超额现金利息。

基准 WACC 从 10.97753678% 降至 9.592269%。模型采用十月十六日国债收益率 5.09%、美国利差 0.22%、调整后 ERP 4.42% 及行业贝塔 1.39；债务权重、利差和成熟期贝塔是分析假设。下行及上行折现率为基准加 120／减 30 基点。

终值增长率为 2.5%／3.0%／3.5%，对应 ROIC 13%／18%／22%。最后预测年及持续经营年度投资均为 NOPAT×增长率／ROIC。年末折现始于 2025 年 12 月 31 日。

十二月流动资产为 1,633.241 百万美元，经营现金储备为 26.41731 百万美元。可转债完整报价请求权为 936.270 百万美元，只扣一次，不重复扣本金或增加转换股数。年末普通股为 31.780111 百万股，与加权稀释股数 32.800 百万股不同。这些历史观察不能确定当前普通股权益。

普通股权益及每股价值被限制。封顶看涨期权公允价值、员工期权价值、绩效奖励完整性及剩余请求权尚未解决。历史封顶期权成本 51.826 百万美元不是公允价值。固定历史可转债价值未按内在情景联立重估。不假定当前报价比较、上涨空间或已执行回购。

新模拟默认值为零宽度，尚未校准。蒙特卡洛仅手动运行。下行、基准、上行情景无指定概率；零宽度试验复现选定经营情景，股权价值仍不可用。

2016–2025 财年 20-F 历史保留逐字段来源链接、申报日期、原始 XBRL 数值和单位。2021–2025 财年加权稀释股数已修正单位，2025 年为 32.800 百万股。缺失值保留为空。收购及 2016 年专利费买断影响可比性。
